summary: Reproduced the reported AttributeError in streaming-response cleanup when cleanup runs before GenerateReqInput normalization. Fixed cleanup to use the request ID shape instead of the normalization-only is_single attribute. The live public /abort_request path was independently verified to return HTTP 200 and terminate an active tiny-Llama stream with an abort finish reason; it does not invoke create_abort_task.

tests.what_was_measured: The unstarted streaming cleanup raised AttributeError because GenerateReqInput.is_single was absent. The raw run also exposed incomplete dispatch mocking in the two boundary tests; those test-only setup errors were corrected before after-fix validation.
Three focused cases passed: cleanup before normalization is a no-op, an active single request is aborted, and every active request in a batch is aborted.
All 29 tests and 3 subtests in the tokenizer-manager request-state cleanup suite passed.
A real SGLang server on gfx950 generated four tokens, /abort_request returned HTTP 200, the stream ended with finish_reason.type=abort, and the server log contained no AttributeError.
Formatting tool availability only: the prepared interpreter does not contain the ruff module. git diff --check was used instead.

gpu_execution_evidence: reports/j-33ad333877d9/evidence/gpu-info.txt identifies the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X as gfx950; evidence/http/http-result.json contains generated token events and the abort finish reason from the live engine.
remaining_limitations: The original meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct weights were unavailable.
The source report used NVIDIA RTX 4090/CUDA, while this job had one AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 with ROCm.
The deterministic tiny random Llama fixture qualifies transport and engine execution only, not semantic accuracy or a different architecture.
The exact claimed causal link from POST /abort_request to create_abort_task was not reproduced: those are separate code paths in this checkout.
After the successful probe, the owned server process exceeded the runner's 30-second graceful-shutdown window and was killed and reaped.
